text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — QA found the new "quick inspect" unmask button in Console. It returns full request bodies for ephemeral debug sessions. I think this bypasses our PII rules.
Jordan Kim: Which flow exactly? can you paste the screenshot/link?
Maya Patel: It's the support quick-inspect. Snippet from the client:
```
POST /v1/inspect/unmask
{ "session_id": "tmp-123", "ttl_sec": 600 }
```
Samir Rao: Yikes. If tenants haven't opted in, we can't return raw PII. :warning:
Lee Chen: Current backend requires admin role + audit log but we never run the full scrub on the inspect return. ops-bot: deploy succeeded for branch "quick-inspect" (2026-05-02T03:12Z) :rocket:
Maya Patel: Proposal: always run an on-the-fly scrubber on payloads returned by unmask endpoints. Offer a "metadata-only" mode that returns only metadata and redacted payload. Keep unmasked data only in ephemeral, HMAC-protected audit links. Suggest TTL 90s by default; require two-person approval for TTL > 600s.
Jordan Kim: UX-wise we should add explicit reason + ticket field when a user requests unmask. Support will complain about friction, but it creates traceability.
Samir Rao: For telemetry, tag traces with `inspect_unmasked` and exclude those from analytics exports automatically. Also emit metrics for sampling vs unmasking.
Lee Chen: Implementation notes: reuse the existing regex+ML PII pipeline but use a stricter config for ephemeral unmask flows (higher recall). Add unit tests and a canary toggle.
Maya Patel: Rollout plan: feature-flag per org (default off), enable for internal tenants first, add a console banner describing retention.
Jordan Kim: Metrics to track: `count_unmask_requests`, `avg_unmask_duration`, `percent_fields_redacted`, `unmask_quota_remaining`
Samir Rao: Also enforce quotas: per-org monthly quota + global rate limit to prevent abuse/exfiltration attempts.
ops-bot: incident created: #1234 assigned to @Lee Chen
Lee Chen: I'll draft an RFC today outlining API changes, GC rules for ephemeral audit links, and the stricter scrub profile. Will include migration notes for existing logs.
Maya Patel: Can we standardize the inspect API response shape so the console can handle metadata-only vs unmasked payloads?
Jordan Kim: Example response shape we can use:
```
{
  "inspected": true,
  "mode": "unmasked|metadata_only",
  "unmasked_fields": ["email", "ssn"],
  "payload": "<REDACTED or full payload depending on mode>",
  "audit_link": "https://console.internal/inspect/audit/abcd1234?sig=HMAC&exp=90s"
}
```
Samir Rao: Note: audit_link must include HMAC + TTL and only surface for users with audit role. Also log an immutable event when link is generated.
Maya Patel: Action items: Lee -> RFC + retention rules, Jordan -> UI mock + reason/ticket flow, Samir -> telemetry tags + quota enforcement proposal, Ops -> incident follow-up and add canary flag.
Lee Chen: I'll target RFC by EOD and a canary next week.
Jordan Kim: I'll have a mock by tomorrow afternoon.
Maya Patel: Thanks all :thumbsup:
